2014_spells.dust-devil.description: Choose an unoccupied 5-foot cube of air that you can see within range. An elemental force of swirling wind appears in the cube and lasts for the spell's duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the swirling wind must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage and is pushed 10 feet away from the cube.
2014_spells.dust-devil.effectSummary: Deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.dust-devil.fullDescription: Using 1 action, choose an unoccupied 5-foot cube of air that you can see within range. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the swirling wind must make a Strength saving throw; roll a d20, add the STR modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; On a failed save, the creature takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage and is pushed 10 feet away from the cube; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd. An elemental force of swirling wind appears in the cube and lasts for the spell's duration; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
